topics.topic: Approval preview file identity requirements and where owners obtain full SpooledFile coordinates
questions: For approval previews, must file inputs include full SpooledFile identity fields (`run_id`, `producer_node_id`, `map_index`, `attempt_number`, `producer_port`, `list_index`) or only digest/size/media_type?
Which operation output gives the owner the exact SpooledFile identity for each file shown in an approval preview?

topics.topic: Run spool lifetime guarantees and how `read_spooled_file`/`surface` must check existence vs return `refused`
questions: Which check order is normative for `read_spooled_file`, and by which operation should `surface` verify SpooledFile existence before deciding `refused` for a run that no longer holds its spool?
Is spool removal required to be completed synchronously at run-end/release, or is best-effort removal with deferred cleanup acceptable?

topics.topic: `store.record_change` contract and exact boundary of store-enforced invariants/consistency checks
questions: For each named change, what exact input shape and required/forbidden fields are mandatory versus store-assigned, and which cross-record consistency checks must store enforce versus trust?
What is the complete, closed list of 'store-owned invariants' per named change (especially referential-existence and cross-record consistency checks)?

topics.topic: Exact per-relation argument tuple for `store.read_records` (including `element` encoding)
questions: What is the exact required argument tuple for each individual relation, and how is 'element' represented in calls?

topics.topic: Whether `get_repair_view` continuation tokens are invalid when paging/request context changes
questions: What must happen if a caller reuses a `get_repair_view` continuation token with changed request context (different slot, different page size, or other differing paging arguments)?

topics.topic: Whether `prepare_request` must normalize credential/installation refusals into pre-send failure results
questions: Must `prepare_request` always convert `credential_unresolved` (and any installation refusal) into a non-refusal pre-send failure result, or may it propagate a refusal upward?

topics.topic: `effects.reach_operation_element` handling of unexpected dependency refusal/error (map to conclusion vs `internal_error`)
questions: If `reach_operation_element` gets an unexpected refusal/error from `bindings.check_binding_current` or `service_invoker.prepare_request` (other than modeled pre-send failure results), must it convert that to an element conclusion (`operation_failed`) or bubble it as `internal_error`?

topics.topic: `list_records` `in`-set filter semantics when set mixes existing and non-existing identities
questions: If an `in`-set filter contains a mix of existing and non-existing referenced identities, must matching use the existing subset, or must any non-existing member make the filter behave as "naming no record" and return empty?

topics.topic: `surface` behavior when one referenced value-byte fetch fails during read assembly (fail whole vs partial)
questions: When `surface` is resolving StoredValue/SpooledFile bytes for a response and `store.read_value_bytes` returns `internal_error` for one referenced value, does the whole MCP operation fail, or may it return partial data with that value omitted/redacted?
